title: Last Beacon
summary: Start: enter Last Beacon. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Buoy Keeper. Do: come within 320 meters of the Buoy Keeper. The keeper slides alongside and names the one lamp that still answers. Everything else is wreck light. Finish: after the keeper is met, come inside Working Buoy's shell. A drift rumor. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
